rule: docs/design/history/src/428-part4-ch28-tooling.md: The editor; docs/design/src/900-appendices.md: Grammar (D419), Contextual words, Declarations, Statements, Expressions, Patterns; metamorphic statement splicing
reason: Appendix Grammar D419, Contextual words requires error to be followed by a binding identifier on the same line to start a declaration; otherwise it is an identifier. Chapter 13, Block params (D188, D376) and Appendix Grammar, CallExpression permit a same-line block after a name. The compiler correctly accepts error{} as a block-param call; tree-sitter rejects it. Renaming the callee to value makes both parsers accept it. No semicolon is inserted between this same-line callee and block.
